comments.text:
Denmark cannot be trusted when it comes to Greenland.
(1) Greenland is of extreme strategic importance to the national security of the United States.
(2) During WWII, Denmark was unable to defend Greenland. The US was forced to defend (& pay for) Greenland's protection.
(3) Denmark is NOT a trustworthy “partner” in Greenland. Denmark reneged on its 2019 commitment (to Trump-1.0) to spend an additional $200million for Greenland's defense. They spent only $2million (1% of their original commitment).
(4) The US will be forced to defend (& pay for) Greenland's protection in Europe's next great war.
Greenland must be ceded to the United States!
